rca of the issue: Root cause: /payments/checkout/booking used to write only `terapeuta_id` (terapisti._id) on the appointment; the fattura generator read `terapeuta_user_id` (users._id), which was never populated → _get_terapeuta_full(None) returned None → raised ValueError → swallowed by the try/except in the webhook path. User saw: payment succeeded, appt confirmed, email confirmation sent, but no fattura. Fix (verified by tests): (a) _resolve_terapeuta_user_id looks up terapisti._id → user_id and backfills the appointment; (b) _emit_fattura_for_paid_tx persists per-step error onto the transaction so admin diagnostics + FatturePage banner surface the failure; (c) /admin/fatture/retry/{id} lets admin re-run one row; (d) create_booking_checkout now writes terapeuta_user_id at creation time so new bookings never hit the bug. Reproduction: insert appuntamenti doc with only terapeuta_id (production shape) and a paid payment_transactions row → GET /admin/fatture/diagnostics returns it in `missing`; POST /admin/fatture/retry/{appt_id} generates FZ-YYYY-NNNN, backfills terapeuta_user_id, clears fattura_error, and email_sent flag returns.
